sentinels.purpose: A fabricated, non-functional, credential-SHAPED string that is NOT a real credential and resolves to nothing. It is NOT planted by this authoring act, which plants nothing; it is the sentinel the AUTHORITY REQUIRES node N05 to use when demonstrating MECHANISM_2 conditions WCM-C1 through WCM-C5, so that process scope, argument absence, removal and positive absence verification are proven WITHOUT a real credential ever entering the demonstration. Declaring it here is the manifest's commitment that the N05 demonstration will be run on a sentinel and never on the live value. It MUST be freshly generated per demonstration run, so a later match cannot be confused with a stale leak from a previous run, and it must never be a real credential.

A canary string used by the redaction controls of this node's own write set. It is a fabricated, non-functional, connection-string-shaped value that resolves to nothing and is never a real credential. It is planted into a scratch copy of the write set so that DN1's grep can be proven to FIRE on it, and the real write set is then grepped and must be clean. Without that positive case, a redaction control that is silently broken and a write set that is genuinely clean are indistinguishable, which is the failure mode a pass-path-only validation always hides.

known_conditions: The bounded v1.0.2 focused re-certification OCCURRED with verdict BOUNDED_RECERT_PASS_WITH_NONBLOCKING_FINDINGS and is NOT MATERIALIZED in the repository. OD-6 ratified MATERIALIZE_GOING_FORWARD and expressly did not reconstruct past verdicts retroactively.

The owner-ratification IC OCCURRED with verdict OWNER_RATIFICATION_IC_PASS_WITH_NONBLOCKING_FINDINGS and is NOT MATERIALIZED. Its findings NB-IC-1 through NB-IC-6 reach this lane as owner-supplied lane input, not as a repository artifact.

The ratification record asserts in four loci (ORS-1..ORS-4) that the bounded recertification has not occurred. Until resolved by a certified mechanism at node N02, the DAG is not traversable past N02 and STOP_FOR_AUTHORITY_CONFLICT is the terminal state.

N16 of the capability companion manifest, which covers STOP_OWNER_DECISION_UNRATIFIED, carries test_file UNKNOWN. There is no automated control for the P0 owner-ratification gate anywhere in the repository. The gate is not weakened on that account.

No in-repo Windows Credential Manager reader, DPAPI wrapper or OS-credential-vault integration exists at AS_OF_TREE. Independently verified in this lane; the single code-file grep hit was a false positive from the identifier foreignKeyTargets matching the alternation member keytar.
MR-1 is structurally unreachable under the ratified OD-2, because a successful PHASE_P1 run proves rolcanlogin = true and OPERATOR PRESTATE READ is NOT ELECTED.
db/prepared/** is a protected surface under scripts/ods-scope.ts DEFAULT_PROTECTED_PATTERNS and NO allocation exists for the conditional MR-3 delivery package.
docs/ops/staging/FIBDB053_AUDITOR_CREDENTIAL_CUSTODY_INVENTORY_v1.0.0.json is ABSENT at AS_OF_TREE. OD-2 selected the path; the ratification record expressly withheld authorization to populate it.
No concrete planned FINAL WITNESS timestamp exists. Under EXEC-NOTE-1, MR-2 is therefore BLOCKED and no exact UTC VALID UNTIL is computable.
MG-2 carried: the hosted state of USAGE on uellix_stella_ops is UNKNOWN in both directions, so REQ-2 is conditional on a hosted measurement and is never pre-authorized.
MG-4 carried: direct-host REACHABILITY is UNKNOWN. The management-plane observation confirms the hostname exists for the ref and does NOT confirm a route.
KG-3 carried: the MR-2 prestate is unobservable from the only identity this lane may hold (E-9) and is recorded as a declared UNKNOWN rather than measured.
Every entry of the HOSTED_STATE_UNKNOWN register HU-1..HU-13 remains exactly as unknown after this derivation as before it. FRESHNESS_CARRYOVER binds.
D-1 remains undeclarable while D1-7 is blocked on the M11 health contract, even if D1-8 were satisfied.

positive_controls.description: CANDIDATE BINDING RE-DERIVED, NOT COPIED. All six effective-package blob hashes recorded in CANDIDATE_BINDING_RE_DERIVED must be re-derivable by git ls-tree -r bee14e0a17fca6c6557b8e5e931fc32af789b49b against the six paths, and all six must equal the values the owner-ratification record records. A control that only checked the authority QUOTES six hashes would pass against an artifact that transcribed them from the ratification record without running git.

THE CANONICAL PHASES ARE THE AUTHORITY'S OWN, NOT INVENTED. CANONICAL_PHASE_DERIVATION.canonical_phases_from_FUTURE_EXECUTION_PHASES must list exactly the six phase keys present in FIBDB053_D1_AUDITOR_CAPABILITY_PROVISIONING_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json FUTURE_EXECUTION_PHASES, by key name, with none added, none omitted and none renamed. Re-derive by reading that object's keys.

EVERY DAG NODE MAPS TO A CANONICAL PHASE OR IS FLAGGED AS DERIVED. Each of the twenty-eight nodes carries a canonical_phase field, and every node whose canonical_phase says Derived must have a corresponding open finding or a named authority clause justifying the derivation. A node that is neither canonical nor justified is an invented act.

ALL TWENTY-THREE FAIL-CLOSED TOKENS ARE PLACED. FAIL_CLOSED_TOKEN_PLACEMENT.placement must contain exactly the twenty-two tokens of FAIL_CLOSED_TOKENS.tokens plus STOP_UNEXPLAINED_PROHIBITED_PRIVILEGE from v1.0.1 SECTION_A5, each spelled byte-identically, each mapped to at least one node id that exists in DAG_NODES. Re-derive the token set from the two source files rather than from this manifest.

NO TOKEN WAS ADDED, REWORDED, REORDERED OR NARROWED. The placement table must introduce no token name absent from the two source files. A DAG that invented a token would be amending a set the authority declares TOTAL over the outcomes it can produce.

THE NINE MR2-PRE PRECONDITIONS EACH CITE A NAMED CLAUSE. Every entry of MR2_CONTRACT.THE_PRECONDITIONS_THIS_DAG_ATTACHES_TO_THE_EDGE_INTO_MR_2.preconditions carries a source naming a clause that exists in the effective package or in the ratification record's execution notes. A precondition with no source is a rule this lane invented.

THE FIVE MECHANISM_2 CONDITIONS ARE CARRIED, NOT PARAPHRASED. Each WCM-C1..WCM-C5 verbatim string must match, byte for byte by programmatic string comparison and not by re-reading, the corresponding entry of SECRET_DELIVERY_CONTRACT.MECHANISM_2_PROCESS_SCOPED.conditions_carried_unchanged_from_the_base_text in the v1.0.1 amendment. This repository has already measured a restatement lane producing three of six quotations incomplete on a first attempt.

THE SIX HC-1 MANDATORY STATEMENTS ARE CARRIED VERBATIM. Each HC1-S1..HC1-S6 verbatim string must match, by programmatic string comparison, the corresponding entry of HUMAN_CONFIRMATION.HC_1_CREDENTIAL_MUTATION.must_state_before_asking. Six entries, not five, and in the authority's own order.

THE WCM NEGATIVE CAPABILITY CLAIM WAS VERIFIED, NOT ACCEPTED. Re-run the recorded grep alternation at AS_OF_TREE. It must return exactly the two files the authority classifies, and a targeted re-grep of db/hosted/authority/certification/prechain-requirements.ts must show the hit is the identifier foreignKeyTargets and not credential-vault code. A control that accepted the IC's finding on its authority would pass against a repository that had since gained a vault reader.

THE FOUR OVER-RESTRICTIVE STATEMENTS WERE FOUND BY GREP, NOT BY MEMORY. Re-run the recorded grep against the ratification record at blob fb0c9f5c5e935ebf43cf86ea2c73545acd2d8a7f. It must return six loci. Each of ORS-1..ORS-4 and ORS-X1..ORS-X2 must cite a line number and a verbatim fragment that the file actually contains at that line. An artifact that named four loci without the grep would have a correct count and an unverified discovery method.

MR-1 UNREACHABILITY IS PROVEN, NOT ASSERTED. MR1_REACHABILITY_DERIVATION.the_derivation must present a chain in which each step cites a clause or a measured engine fact, and the conclusion must follow. Specifically: P1 runs inside an authenticated session (PHASE_P1.precondition), a NOLOGIN role cannot open one, and OD-2 ratified OPERATOR PRESTATE READ: NOT ELECTED. If any single link is absent, the node must not be marked DECLARED_UNREACHABLE.

MR-1 IS RETAINED, NOT DELETED. Node N16 must be present in DAG_NODES, must carry its trigger, its statement, its human confirmation HC-3 and its token STOP_LOGIN_ATTRIBUTE_MUTATION_FAILED, and must state the conditions under which it becomes reachable. A DAG that dropped MR-1 would be silently withdrawing a mutation the authority authorizes.

THE SSL-06 INVENTORY TIMING IS DERIVED FROM THE CONTRACT SENTENCE. SSL06_INVENTORY_PREREQUISITE must quote SECRET_CUSTODY_CONTRACT.SSL_06_ADJUDICATION.CONSEQUENT_BINDING_REQUIREMENT's before-the-credential-is-minted sentence and must place BEAT_1 strictly before N10 and N11. The eight fields it names must be partitioned into the seven knowable pre-mint and the one (mint date) that is not.

THE CUSTODY UPDATE IS AN UPDATE, NOT A SECOND ENTRY. BEAT_2 must cite SECRET_ROTATION_CONTRACT.rotation_mechanics' same-custody-entry-updated-rather-than-appended-twice rule, and node N12's act must say UPDATE and must say do not append.

THE OD-3 CHAIN HAS ALL FIVE STEPS IN ORDER. OD3_TIME_MATERIALIZATION.THE_REQUIRED_CHAIN must run planned witness time, then compute plus 24 hours as an exact UTC instant, then show it inside HC-1, then owner confirms, then MR-2. Steps 1 and 2 must map to N08 and N09, and step 1 must carry the EXEC-NOTE-1 consequence that MR-2 is BLOCKED if it is absent.

THE MR-3 TRIGGER IS A THREE-WAY CONJUNCTION. MR3_CONDITIONAL_PATH.THE_TRIGGER_IS_A_CONJUNCTION_OF_THREE must carry KP-3 true, KP-5 false AND the protected-surface allocation existing, and node N15 must evaluate all three. A DAG that drew MR-3 as firing on the measurement alone would licence a grant with no allocation.

THE MR-3 POSTSTATE ASSERTS THREE BOOLEANS. Node N21 must require USAGE true AND CREATE false AND EXECUTE false on each canonical signature, and must state why the second and third are what make it adversarial. A poststate asserting only the first would pass a GRANT ALL.

THE FORBIDDEN-SUBSTITUTION LIST IS COMPLETE. PRECHECK_R2_ENTRY_CONTRACT.THE_ONLY_AUTHORIZED_CREDENTIAL.NEVER_SUBSTITUTED_BY must contain all ten entries of the capability authority's own carried list, and the mandate's four categories (runtime URL, migrator URL, admin or postgres credential, operator credential) must each map onto entries already in it, with no new prohibition invented and none dropped.

THE TWO BACKWARD EDGES ARE DISTINCT AND CORRECTLY TARGETED. E-SLIP must run from N27 to N08 and must re-enter the mutation arm with a fresh HC-1. E-FRESH must run from N27 to N22 and must NOT re-enter the mutation arm. A single collapsed loop would either force a needless re-rotation or carry a stale credential through a re-verified poststate.

EVERY DERIVED OBLIGATION BEYOND THE AUTHORITY TEXT IS FLAGGED. Each of the three obligations this artifact attaches that the authority's own text does not contain (child-process non-inheritance, vault-read logging, vault handle prohibited in the custody entry) must carry an OF-DAG id, and each re-sequencing of a canonical phase obligation must carry one too. An unflagged addition is an amendment wearing a derivation's name.

THE MANIFEST VALIDATES AGAINST ITS SCHEMA. This file must validate against docs/ops/ods/UELLIX_TEST_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_v1.0.0.json by a real JSON Schema validator, not by inspection: every required key present, every type correct, additionalProperties false honoured at the root and in every control, and every exit_gates entry drawn from the schema's own enum. This repository has already measured a manifest violating its own schema while its PR asserted schema PASS, and no repository gate validates a TEST_MANIFEST against this schema.

THE WRITE SET IS EXACTLY TWO NEW FILES AND TOUCHES NO PROTECTED SURFACE. git diff --name-status against the parent must show exactly two additions, both under docs/ops/release/, and pnpm ods:scope must report zero protected violations and zero unauthorized paths with the allow pattern covering only docs/ops/release/**.

EVERY FILE OF THE EFFECTIVE CAPABILITY PACKAGE AND THE RATIFICATION RECORD IS BYTE-UNCHANGED. Re-derive all seven blob hashes at the candidate head and compare against the parent. Any difference means this lane edited an append-only artifact, which is a hard failure regardless of intent.

negative_controls.description: NO SECRET VALUE ANYWHERE. Grep the authority, this manifest, the commit message and the PR body for three families: a base64url-shaped run of 32 bytes or more that is not a git object id and not an UPPER_SNAKE or kebab identifier; a postgres connection-scheme prefix; and a URL userinfo segment carrying a colon-separated secret before an at-sign. Any hit is RED. THE GREP MUST EXCLUDE THE CONTROL DESCRIPTIONS IN THIS MANIFEST, which necessarily describe the patterns they hunt: a control whose own text matches its pattern fires RED on a clean write set and is therefore useless. Exercised positively by SENT-DAG-2 so the grep is proven to fire on a real planted value rather than passing because it never matches anything.

NO UTC TIMESTAMP IMPLEMENTING OD-3. Grep both files for any ISO-8601 instant, any Z-suffixed time and any expression of the form plus 24 hours applied to a concrete date. Only the materialization date 2026-09-22 and the dates appearing inside carried quotations may be present, and none of them may be presented as a VALID UNTIL. A computed expiry in an authoring artifact is an invented operand wearing a policy's name.

NEITHER CANONICAL LITERAL APPEARS. Grep both files for the nine-argument and seven-argument canonical signature literals from the grandparent's CANONICAL_SIGNATURE_CONTRACT. Neither may appear, in whole or composed from parts. Resolving or even carrying them here is mutant M20 territory, and the authority's own SQ-6 and SQ-7 prohibition binds the provisioning lane.

NO OWNER NOTE IS AUTHORED. Neither file may contain a draft, template, skeleton, suggested wording or fill-in form for the certification-occurrence note. A section that described what the note must establish is permitted and required; a section a reader could sign is RED. The distinction is whether the text could be lifted and used as the owner's own statement.

NO RETROACTIVE VERDICT ARTIFACT. No file is created under any certification-verdict path for CV1-D1-AUDITOR-CAPABILITY-IC-R1, CV1-D1-AUDITOR-CAPABILITY-FOCUSED-RECERT-R1, the bounded v1.0.2 recertification or the owner-ratification IC. OD-6 ratified going-forward only, and reconstructing a past verdict is writing history rather than recording it.

THE CERTIFICATION STATUS IS NOT COLLAPSED. P0_CERTIFICATION_STATUS must not state a bare did-occur or did-not-occur for any of the four events. Each must carry status, verdict and materialized_in_repository as separate fields. A single boolean would reproduce exactly the defect NB-IC-2 asks this DAG to correct.

THE ABSENCE OF A MATERIALIZED VERDICT IS NOT TREATED AS ABSENCE OF A VERDICT. The repository sweep finding no certification-verdict artifact must be recorded as CONSISTENT WITH non-materialization and explicitly NOT as evidence of non-occurrence. An artifact that inferred non-occurrence from the sweep would be making the same error in the opposite direction from ORS-1.

THE P0 GATE IS NOT WEAKENED BY N16's UNKNOWN test_file. Node N03 must NOT cite a test as its evidence, must NOT be marked satisfied-by-default, and must NOT reduce the requirement below six of six ratified and blob-bound. A DAG that treated the missing control as permission to relax the gate fails this control.

WRONG PROJECT REF => STOP. Node N04 must refuse any ref other than bvyzblhqymxruxdguaee, and any act resolving to ctaxtgujyyprgynmnvtq by any path including by name must fire STOP_PRODUCTION_TARGET_REFUSED. A control that only checked internal consistency would pass on a perfectly self-consistent identity for the wrong database.

SELECTION BY NAME => STOP. The authority must state that the production-vetoed ref carries the name uellix-staging and the authorized ref carries Uellix Staging, and that selecting by name selects the vetoed project. A DAG that permitted a human-readable label to select a target at any node fails.

MR-2 WITHOUT ANY ONE OF THE NINE PRECONDITIONS => NOT AUTHORIZED. Remove any single MR2-PRE entry and the edge into N11 must no longer be satisfiable. If the graph still permits MR-2 with eight of nine, that precondition was decorative.

MR-2 WITHOUT A CONCRETE PLANNED WITNESS TIME => BLOCKED, NOT DEFAULTED. With N08 unsatisfied, MR-2 must be BLOCKED. Any default, estimate, open-ended VALID UNTIL or omitted expiry is RED. EXEC-NOTE-1 forbids all four by name.

VALID UNTIL EXTENSION => PROHIBITED. No node, edge or loop may reach ALTER ROLE uellix_auditor VALID UNTIL with a later instant. The slip case must reach E-SLIP and a re-rotation. A graph offering an extension path anywhere, including as a documented fallback, fails.

SETX OR USER-SCOPE PERSISTENCE => PROHIBITED. Neither file may present setx, the System Properties environment UI, or any user-scope persistent variable as an option, a fallback or a conditional election. v1.0.1 ruled MECHANISM_1 NOT ACCEPTABLE, ABSOLUTE, AND NOT AN OWNER ELECTION, and v1.0.2 SPC102-1 removed it from OD-2's selectable set.

A WCM MECHANISM DEMONSTRATING FOUR OF FIVE CONDITIONS => STOP_SECRET_DELIVERY_NONCOMPLIANT. Node N05's exit condition must require ALL FIVE. Any partial-credit reading fails. A mechanism that cannot satisfy every one of them is not used.

THE N05 DEMONSTRATION ON A REAL CREDENTIAL => RED. The demonstration must use SENT-DAG-1 and never the live value. Proving a removal mechanism by removing a real credential tests the mechanism and leaks the secret in the same act.

MR-3 WITHOUT A PROTECTED-SURFACE ALLOCATION => STOP_PROTECTED_SURFACE_ALLOCATION_ABSENT. Node N20 must be unreachable unless N17 closed. A path from N15 directly to N20 on the measurement alone is RED.

MR-3 AS AN AD-HOC STATEMENT => RED. Node N18 must require the governed db/prepared/** package. Any node, note or fallback offering a loose GRANT executed under an execution authority is RED, notwithstanding that the authority records that alternative as materially smaller. It was recorded and NOT chosen, and OD-5 ratified the package route.

GRANT ISSUED BEFORE THE MEASUREMENT => RED. No edge may permit N20 before N14 has recorded KP-5 as a boolean. Granting on repository intent rather than hosted prestate is mutant M23 and mutant M24 at once.
EXECUTE GRANTED => RED. No node may grant EXECUTE on either canonical signature, and N21 must assert EXECUTE false. USAGE_IS_NOT_EXECUTE is unchanged and controlling.

REVOKE OF A PRE-EXISTING PRIVILEGE => RED. A prohibited privilege found at N14, N21 or N22 that this artifact did not create must fire STOP_UNEXPLAINED_PROHIBITED_PRIVILEGE and be RECORDED, never silently revoked. Revoking would destroy the evidence of how it arrived.
MR-3 ROLLBACK ON A TRUE PRESTATE => RED. The REVOKE must be issued ONLY if the recorded prestate was false. Revoking after a true prestate would remove a privilege this act did not create.

OPERATOR PRESTATE READ => NOT AUTHORIZED. No node may connect as postgres, supabase_admin, service_role, authenticator, uellix_owner or uellix_migrator, or reach any role by SET ROLE from them. OD-2 as ratified elects NOT ELECTED, and a DAG that reintroduced the operator path to make MR-1 reachable would be smuggling operator access into a read-only audit.

SESSION POOLER FOR THE AUDITOR => REFUSED. The connection mechanism must be direct-db only. Any widening of projectRefFromPoolerUser or parseQualifiedPoolerUser to admit uellix_auditor is outside this write set and would weaken the one signal the pooler branch has.

CREDENTIAL LEFT SET BETWEEN PRECHECK-R2 AND THE FINAL WITNESS => RED. Two deliveries and two removals, each with its own positive absence verification. A single delivery spanning both runs is a credential resident across an interval bounded by nothing but the operator's memory.

REMOVAL ASSERTED FROM THE COMMAND RATHER THAN FROM A CHECK => STOP_CREDENTIAL_REMOVAL_UNVERIFIED. Node N24's exit condition must be a boolean from a positive absence check, recorded as a FIELD so its absence is a hole rather than a silence.

PRECHECK-R2 OPENED BEFORE INDEPENDENT POSTSTATE CERTIFICATION => RED. The edge into N27 must require N26. A DAG that let the executing lane certify its own poststate and proceed would collapse macro-chain nodes 6 and 7.

A CAPABILITY CONFIRMATION OFFERED TO PRECHECK-R2 => RED. None of HC-1, HC-2 or HC-3 may be carried into N27. PRECHECK-R2 obtains its own under the PARENT's HUMAN_CONFIRMATION immediately before its first hosted connection.

THE PROVISIONING LANE OBSERVING => RED. No node may evaluate SQ-6 or SQ-7 or resolve either canonical literal. The provisioning lane establishes that the capability CAN observe; it does not observe. Mutant M20.

A VAULT HANDLE IN THE CUSTODY ENTRY => RED. The custody inventory may carry names, roles and custody metadata only. A retrievable handle, entry key or lookup token is prohibited, as a derived obligation flagged OF-DAG-6.

mutation_controls.description: MUTANT — DELETE NODE N02. Remove the certification-occurrence node and wire N01 straight to N10. Expected: DN4, DN6, DN7 and the OF-DAG-10 finding all go RED, and the graph would traverse to a hosted mutation while the repository record asserts the gating certification has not occurred. If anything stays green, the owner-note dependency was decoration.

MUTANT — CLOSE N02 BY CITING THIS ARTIFACT'S OWN CERTIFICATION. Make N02's exit condition the independent certification of the DAG rather than an owner statement about an occurrence. Expected: RED. A certification of a derivation is not an owner statement about a past act, and this mutant is the most plausible shortcut a downstream lane would reach for.

MUTANT — RECONSTRUCT THE BOUNDED RECERT VERDICT AS AN ARTIFACT TO CLOSE N02. Expected: DN5 goes RED and OD-6's going-forward-only scope is violated. This mutant matters because it is the reading that makes N02 closable without the owner, and it is exactly what NB-IC-3 forbids.

MUTANT — DECLARE THE BOUNDED RECERTIFICATION NEVER OCCURRED, on the strength of the repository sweep finding no verdict artifact. Expected: DN7 goes RED. This is the symmetric error to ORS-1 and it is the one a fail-closed instinct would produce, so it must be caught by a control rather than by good judgement.

MUTANT — MOVE N05 BACK INTO PHASE_P4, after N22. Expected: the MR2-PRE-5 precondition vanishes and MR-2 becomes reachable with an undemonstrated delivery path. DP6 and DN11 go RED. If the graph still looks sound, the hoist argued at OF-DAG-5 was never load-bearing and the finding should say so.

MUTANT — MOVE N06 AFTER N11. Expected: the custody entry no longer exists before the mint, violating SECRET_CUSTODY_CONTRACT's before-the-credential-is-minted sentence, and HC1-S5 and HC1-S6 become statements about a record that does not exist. DP13 goes RED.

MUTANT — APPEND A SECOND CUSTODY ENTRY AT N12 INSTEAD OF UPDATING. Expected: DP14 goes RED. The inventory then reports two holders of one credential, which is the failure an inventory exists to prevent, and it would compound on every rotation.

MUTANT — DROP HC1-S4 FROM THE HC-1 STATEMENT LIST. Expected: DP8 goes RED and the owner confirms a mint without being shown the expiry. This is the single most likely omission under time pressure, because HC1-S4 is the only statement whose value must be computed rather than transcribed.

MUTANT — SUBSTITUTE A DEFAULT VALID UNTIL WHEN N08 IS ABSENT, for example 48 hours from the mint. Expected: DN12 goes RED. It is the most natural way to unblock a stalled sequence and EXEC-NOTE-1 names it as prohibited in four forms.

MUTANT — REPLACE E-SLIP WITH A VALID UNTIL EXTENSION EDGE. Expected: DN13 goes RED. The extension is cheaper than a re-rotation at exactly the moment a witness is nearly finished, which is precisely when OD-3's refusal is under most pressure.

MUTANT — REUSE HC-1 FOR THE RE-ROTATION REACHED BY E-SLIP. Expected: RED. Confirmations are not transferable and are spent when their act completes. A re-rotation on a spent confirmation is a hosted credential mutation nobody consented to.

MUTANT — COLLAPSE E-SLIP AND E-FRESH INTO ONE LOOP TARGETING N08. Expected: DP19 goes RED. Every stale poststate then forces a needless credential rotation, which makes operators avoid the loop, which is how a control that is too expensive becomes a control that is not run.

MUTANT — COLLAPSE E-SLIP AND E-FRESH INTO ONE LOOP TARGETING N22. Expected: DP19 goes RED in the other direction. A slipped window then re-verifies a poststate while carrying a credential past its policy expiry.

MUTANT — MARK N16 REACHABLE AND DRAW A LIVE EDGE FROM N14. Expected: DP11 goes RED. The mutant is plausible because the authority lists MR-1 without qualification, and only the reachability derivation catches it.

MUTANT — DELETE NODE N16 ENTIRELY, on the ground that it is unreachable. Expected: DP12 goes RED. Deleting it would silently withdraw a mutation the capability authority authorizes, which a derivation lane has no power to do. Unreachable and unauthorized are different states and the DAG must hold them apart.

MUTANT — INFER NOLOGIN FROM THE AUTHENTICATION FAILURE AT N11 AND ISSUE ALTER ROLE LOGIN. Expected: RED. E-9 measured that no-credential, wrong-credential and NOLOGIN are indistinguishable from the client, so the inference is unsound and the ALTER would reverse a decision the artifact cannot see.

MUTANT — PICK ONE TOKEN AT N11 FOR THE NOLOGIN CASE INSTEAD OF RECORDING BOTH. Expected: RED. Choosing between STOP_CREDENTIAL_MUTATION_FAILED and STOP_AUDITOR_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED is a diagnosis E-9 proves cannot be made, and RULE_FAIL_CLOSED_ON_UNKNOWN forbids picking the more convenient source.

MUTANT — MAKE N17 UNCONDITIONAL, seeking the protected-surface allocation before N14 measures. Expected: DN19 goes RED and an allocation is requested on an unmeasured need. This is the mutant the strict reading of expected_sequence node 4 would force, and it is why OF-DAG-1 exists.

MUTANT — DROP MR3-T3 FROM THE TRIGGER CONJUNCTION. Expected: DP16 and DN17 go RED and MR-3 fires on the measurement alone, with no allocation. The mutant is plausible because the authority states the trigger in two places and one of them leads with the measurement.

MUTANT — ASSERT ONLY has_schema_privilege USAGE TRUE AT N21. Expected: DP17 goes RED. A GRANT ALL typed instead of GRANT USAGE would then pass the poststate, which is the exact failure the three-boolean form exists to catch.

MUTANT — CALL has_schema_privilege BEFORE to_regnamespace AT N14. Expected: STOP_STELLA_OPS_SCHEMA_ABSENT never fires and an absent schema raises an unhandled 3F000 instead of producing a named outcome. E-6 measured the raise; E-11 measured that to_regprocedure does not raise, so the two cannot be assumed to behave alike.

MUTANT — TREAT A FAVOURABLE KP-5 AS A CLEAN RESULT AND RECORD NOTHING. Expected: RED. A hosted grant no repository package explains is a privilege nobody can cite the origin of, and MG-1 measured that no package grants it. Skipping MR-3 is correct; passing over the anomaly is not.

MUTANT — FIRE STOP_UNEXPLAINED_PROHIBITED_PRIVILEGE ON THE FAVOURABLE KP-5. Expected: RED in the opposite direction. That token covers the PROHIBITED rows PV-24..PV-28 only, and firing it on a REQUIRED row would halt the lane on a favourable measurement.

MUTANT — SUBSTITUTE postgres FOR uellix_auditor AT ANY HOSTED NODE. Expected: DN23 goes RED and the SSL-06 operator tripwire fires. This mutant matters most against N22, because a postgres session would satisfy every read assertion trivially while proving nothing about the auditor.

MUTANT — DELIVER THE CREDENTIAL VIA .env.audit.local. Expected: RED. Uniquely plausible because db/safety/resolve-capability-database-url.ts:18 NAMES that file for the auditor, so an obedient executor following the code comment writes a live hosted credential into the worktree. MRS_4 adjudicates the conflict and the parent wins.

MUTANT — DELIVER THE CREDENTIAL VIA A VERCEL ENVIRONMENT VARIABLE OR vercel env pull. Expected: RED. No deployed runtime consumes the auditor capability, so a Vercel-resident auditor credential would exist only to be leaked, and env pull writes real values into the working tree.

MUTANT — ADD A TWENTY-FOURTH FAIL-CLOSED TOKEN FOR THE N08 BLOCKED STATE. Expected: DP5 goes RED. The token set is declared TOTAL over the outcomes the authority can produce, and BLOCKED is a wait for an owner input rather than a failure. Adding a token would be an amendment, and the correct treatment is the named non-token state.

MUTANT — REWORD ONE CARRIED VERBATIM STRING BY A SINGLE WORD, in the five MECHANISM_2 conditions or the six HC-1 statements. Expected: DP7 or DP8 goes RED. The control must be a programmatic string comparison; a re-read would not catch a single-word drift, and this repository has already measured a restatement lane producing three of six quotations incomplete on a first attempt.

MUTANT — TRANSCRIBE THE SIX BLOB HASHES FROM THE RATIFICATION RECORD WITHOUT RUNNING git ls-tree. Expected: DP1 must go RED.
